title: Green AI: A systematic review and meta-analysis of its definitions, lifecycle models, hardware and measurement attempts
reasoning: The paper is a systematic review focused on the environmental sustainability of AI (Green AI), including energy, carbon, and water footprints. While it mentions ethical obligations and fairness as part of its delimitation from the broader concept of 'Sustainable AI' and as potential trade-offs, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
